title: Habit tracker
audience: For anyone building a few small daily habits.
description: A daily habit tracker your AI fills in. Tell ChatGPT or Claude what you did today and it logs the row in Amber Notes.
note:
Habit tracker

One row a day. Tick it off yourself, or tell your AI what you did and it logs the row.

<!-- pane-table: Date=date; Walk=choice Yes|No; Read=choice Yes|No; No phone in bed=choice Yes|No; Water (glasses)=number; Note=text -->
| Date | Walk | Read | No phone in bed | Water (glasses) | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Habits
- Walk: 30 minutes outside
- Read: 20 pages
- No phone in bed: it charges in the kitchen
- Water: 8 glasses

## Weekly check-in

instructions.name: ChatGPT
instructions.prompt:
First, look for a note called "Habit tracker" in my Amber Notes with search_notes. If there isn't one, create it with create_note in the folder "Habits", using exactly the markdown at the end of this message, the <!-- pane-table --> line included (it gives the table's columns their types).

Then: Use my Amber Notes note "Habit tracker". When I tell you what I did today, log one row with log_table_row: Yes or No for Walk, Read and No phone in bed, Water (glasses) as a number, and anything else in Note. If today already has a row, it gets updated, which is fine. When I ask for my week, read the table with read_table and add three short lines under "Weekly check-in" with append_to_note: what went well, what slipped, and one thing to try next week.


| Date | Walk | Read | No phone in bed | Water (glasses) | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-09-28 | Yes | Yes | No | 6 | Late call with the US team |
| 2026-09-29 | Yes | No | Yes | 8 |   |
| 2026-09-30 | No | Yes | Yes | 7 | Rain all day |

## Habits
- Walk: 30 minutes outside
- Read: 20 pages
- No phone in bed: it charges in the kitchen
- Water: 8 glasses

## Weekly check-in
**Week of 28 September.** Phone stayed out of the bedroom two nights out of three. Walking slipped when it rained. Next week: a 15-minute indoor walk counts on rainy days.
